name: @pipeworx/mcp-dubai-land

tools.name: dld_search_transactions
tools.description: Dubai property transactions (sales, mortgages and gifts) registered with the Dubai Land Department, with transaction value, procedure, area/district, project, property type, room count and nearest metro/mall/landmark. Coverage is the current calendar year — earlier years come back empty. A date range is required.

from_date.description: Start of the range, ISO date e.g. "2026-09-01"

to_date.description: End of the range, ISO date e.g. "2026-09-06"

transaction_type.description: Group: "1" Sales, "2" Mortgages, "3" Gifts. Omit for all.

usage.description: Property usage: "1" Residential, "2" Commercial, "3" Other. Omit for all.

property_type_id.description: Upstream property-type id, as seen in PROPERTY_TYPE_ID

offset.description: Rows to skip, for paging through `total` (default 0)

sort.description: Sort as "<COLUMN>_ASC" or "<COLUMN>_DESC" using a column name from the rows, e.g. "TRANS_VALUE_DESC". Omit for the upstream default order.

include_arabic.description: Keep the Arabic (`*_AR`) twin of each bilingual column. Default false.

tools.name: dld_search_rents
tools.description: Dubai rental contracts registered through Ejari with the Dubai Land Department — contract amount, annual amount, start/end dates, area/district, property type and size. Coverage is the current calendar year. A date range is required.

from_date.description: Start of the range, ISO date e.g. "2026-09-01"

to_date.description: End of the range, ISO date e.g. "2026-09-06"

date_type.description: Which date the range applies to: "0" registration, "1" contract start, "2" contract end

version.description: Contract version filter, as seen in VERSION_EN (e.g. New, Renewed)

offset.description: Rows to skip, for paging through `total` (default 0)

sort.description: Sort as "<COLUMN>_ASC" or "<COLUMN>_DESC" using a column name from the rows, e.g. "TRANS_VALUE_DESC". Omit for the upstream default order.

include_arabic.description: Keep the Arabic (`*_AR`) twin of each bilingual column. Default false.

tools.name: dld_search_valuations
tools.description: Official property valuations recorded by the Dubai Land Department — appraised total value, actual area, property sub-type, area/district and valuation date. Coverage is the current calendar year. A date range is required.

from_date.description: Start of the range, ISO date e.g. "2026-09-01"

to_date.description: End of the range, ISO date e.g. "2026-09-06"

offset.description: Rows to skip, for paging through `total` (default 0)

sort.description: Sort as "<COLUMN>_ASC" or "<COLUMN>_DESC" using a column name from the rows, e.g. "TRANS_VALUE_DESC". Omit for the upstream default order.

include_arabic.description: Keep the Arabic (`*_AR`) twin of each bilingual column. Default false.

tools.name: dld_search_projects
tools.description: Real-estate development projects registered with the Dubai Land Department — developer, project status, percent complete, start/completion dates and location. A date range AND a date_type are both required; without date_type the upstream returns nothing.

from_date.description: Start of the range, ISO date e.g. "2026-09-01"

to_date.description: End of the range, ISO date e.g. "2026-09-06"

date_type.description: Which project date the range applies to: "1" start, "2" end, "3" adoption, "4" completion

offset.description: Rows to skip, for paging through `total` (default 0)

sort.description: Sort as "<COLUMN>_ASC" or "<COLUMN>_DESC" using a column name from the rows, e.g. "TRANS_VALUE_DESC". Omit for the upstream default order.

include_arabic.description: Keep the Arabic (`*_AR`) twin of each bilingual column. Default false.

tools.name: dld_search_lands
tools.description: Registered land parcels in Dubai from the Dubai Land Department — parcel and land number, area/district, zone, land type, actual area, project and master project. No date range; filter by land type, zone or project name.

land_type_id.description: Land type: "1" Residential, "2" Agricultural, "3" Industrial, "4" Commercial, "5" Public Facilities, "6" Government Authority

offset.description: Rows to skip, for paging through `total` (default 0)

sort.description: Sort as "<COLUMN>_ASC" or "<COLUMN>_DESC" using a column name from the rows, e.g. "TRANS_VALUE_DESC". Omit for the upstream default order.

include_arabic.description: Keep the Arabic (`*_AR`) twin of each bilingual column. Default false.

tools.name: dld_search_buildings
tools.description: Registered buildings in Dubai from the Dubai Land Department — building number, floors, rooms, flats/shops/offices counts, actual area, area/district, zone, project and creation date. No date range needed; filter by zone, freehold, leasehold or off-plan status.

offset.description: Rows to skip, for paging through `total` (default 0)

sort.description: Sort as "<COLUMN>_ASC" or "<COLUMN>_DESC" using a column name from the rows, e.g. "TRANS_VALUE_DESC". Omit for the upstream default order.

include_arabic.description: Keep the Arabic (`*_AR`) twin of each bilingual column. Default false.

tools.name: dld_list_brokers
tools.description: Licensed real-estate brokers on the Dubai Land Department register — broker number and name, licence start/end dates, the brokerage office they sit under, and the office phone published on the register.

gender.description: Registered gender: "0" male, "1" female. Omit for all.

offset.description: Rows to skip, for paging through `total` (default 0)

sort.description: Sort as "<COLUMN>_ASC" or "<COLUMN>_DESC" using a column name from the rows, e.g. "TRANS_VALUE_DESC". Omit for the upstream default order.

include_arabic.description: Keep the Arabic (`*_AR`) twin of each bilingual column. Default false.

tools.name: dld_list_developers
tools.description: Real-estate developers registered with the Dubai Land Department — developer number and name, licence dates and contact details. A date range is required and is matched against the licence dates.

from_date.description: Start of the range, ISO date e.g. "2026-09-01"

to_date.description: End of the range, ISO date e.g. "2026-09-06"

offset.description: Rows to skip, for paging through `total` (default 0)

sort.description: Sort as "<COLUMN>_ASC" or "<COLUMN>_DESC" using a column name from the rows, e.g. "TRANS_VALUE_DESC". Omit for the upstream default order.

include_arabic.description: Keep the Arabic (`*_AR`) twin of each bilingual column. Default false.

tools.name: dld_list_areas
tools.description: The Dubai Land Department register of area (district) names in English and Arabic with their AREA_ID codes — the reference list behind the AREA_EN values on transaction, rent and valuation rows.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-dubai-land forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the dubai-land pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
